cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); Private collection, 1937; Rehn Gallery, New York, NY, before 1970; Private collection, New York, NY, before 1970; Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 2999, lot no. 30, 4 March 1970; (William Zierler, Inc., New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Infor. from Mrs. Edgar L. Berkley. . . . March 1946: 'I also own 'The Shell' 1934 by Georgia O'Keeffe. It is a pastel 15 x 10 ins. This was purchased from Stieglitz also, in January 1937. It is labeled on the back in Stieglitz's handwriting [notes inscription 1]. Mrs. Berkley has not had this photographed. Note: Not listed in 1935 exh." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: From Yale letters: Bought from A.S. in 1937." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date c. 1934. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1934. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, backing inscription 1.
titles.title: The Shell

description: Smooth, abstract forms in shades of pink, pale blue, and white echo the rippling surface of a shell.
